opening.argument: The presentation promotes purchasing mining shares or contracts through Bit Club as a path to daily dividends and high monthly income. It describes shares as mining equipment and a joining contract as physical bitcoin hardware, while stating that half of a daily dividend can fund another share. It also invites participants to earn additional bonuses and commissions by sharing the offer. The presentation goes further by asserting perpetual income and a reported 400 percent return, even while acknowledging concerns that the opportunity could be a Ponzi scheme. The described records do not verify those returns, earnings, contract terms, or payment outcomes.
